original_proposal.purpose: 用独立合成凭证分别生成两种利息冲减呈现形式的docx并解压回读，验证(a)docx真实写入可回读、(b)用户逐字示例的负数借方形式与历史AI的贷方正数形式各自是否借贷平衡且不含财务费用—利息收入，以解决u1的呈现歧义

scripts.baseline:
import os, zipfile
from xml.sax.saxutils import escape
os.makedirs("outputs", exist_ok=True)
OUT = os.path.join("outputs", "cmp_baseline_negative_debit.docx")

def cell(v):
    if v is None:
        return "<w:tc><w:p/></w:tc>"
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        txt = ("%g" % v) if float(v).is_integer() else ("%.2f" % v)
    else:
        txt = v
    return '<w:tc><w:p><w:r><w:t xml:space="preserve">%s</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc>' % escape(str(txt))

# 利息凭证：baseline = 用户逐字示例形式：借 银行存款 X / 借 财务费用—手续费 -X
rows = [("收银行存款利息", "银行存款", 4.23, None),
        ("", "财务费用—手续费", -4.23, None)]
body = "".join("<w:tr>%s</w:tr>" % "".join(cell(c) for c in r) for r in rows)
doc = '<?xml version="1.0"?><w:document xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"><w:body><w:tbl>%s</w:tbl></w:body></w:document>' % body
ct = '<?xml version="1.0"?><Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types"><Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/><Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/><Override PartName="/word/document.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document.main+xml"/></Types>'
rels = '<?xml version="1.0"?><Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" Target="word/document.xml"/></Relationships>'
with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    z.writestr("[Content_Types].xml", ct)
    z.writestr("_rels/.rels", rels)
    z.writestr("word/document.xml", doc)

assert os.path.exists(OUT) and os.path.getsize(OUT) > 0
with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT) as z:
    assert "word/document.xml" in z.namelist()
    xml = z.read("word/document.xml").decode("utf-8")
assert "财务费用—手续费" in xml
assert "财务费用—利息收入" not in xml
assert "-4.23" in xml
# 借贷平衡：借方合计 4.23 + (-4.23) = 0 == 贷方合计 0
dr = 4.23 + (-4.23)
cr = 0.0
assert abs(dr - cr) < 1e-9
print("baseline negative_debit OK")

import os, zipfile
from xml.sax.saxutils import escape
os.makedirs("outputs", exist_ok=True)
OUT = os.path.join("outputs", "cmp_variant_credit_positive.docx")

def cell(v):

        return "<w:tc><w:p/></w:tc>"
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        txt = ("%g" % v) if float(v).is_integer() else ("%.2f" % v)
    else:
        txt = v
    return '<w:tc><w:p><w:r><w:t xml:space="preserve">%s</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc>' % escape(str(txt))

# 利息凭证：variant = 历史AI呈现形式：借 银行存款 X / 贷 财务费用—手续费 X（贷方正数）
rows = [("收银行存款利息", "银行存款", 4.23, None),
        ("", "财务费用—手续费", None, 4.23)]
body = "".join("<w:tr>%s</w:tr>" % "".join(cell(c) for c in r) for r in rows)
doc = '<?xml version="1.0"?><w:document xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"><w:body><w:tbl>%s</w:tbl></w:body></w:document>' % body
ct = '<?xml version="1.0"?><Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types"><Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/><Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/><Override PartName="/word/document.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document.main+xml"/></Types>'
rels = '<?xml version="1.0"?><Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" Target="word/document.xml"/></Relationships>'
with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    z.writestr("[Content_Types].xml", ct)
    z.writestr("_rels/.rels", rels)
    z.writestr("word/document.xml", doc)

assert os.path.exists(OUT) and os.path.getsize(OUT) > 0
with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT) as z:
    assert "word/document.xml" in z.namelist()
    xml = z.read("word/document.xml").decode("utf-8")
assert "财务费用—手续费" in xml
assert "财务费用—利息收入" not in xml
assert "-4.23" not in xml
assert "4.23" in xml
# 借贷平衡：借方合计 4.23 == 贷方合计 4.23
dr = 4.23
cr = 4.23
assert abs(dr - cr) < 1e-9
print("variant credit_positive OK")
